$note: 遷移宮（2026-10-12）：貪狼.遷移。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 遷移宮 p.496–515。客死異鄉、異鄉染病、官非、冤獄、被盜、意外一類斷語不用；天月、天刑、龍池鳳閣等引擎冇嘅星不用；要睇廟陷嘅條文暫不用。

rules.text: 貪狼在遷移宮，你在外應酬多，人際往來頻繁。
rules.en: With Tan Lang in your Travel Palace, there is a lot of socialising when you are away, with people coming and going.

rules.text: 貪狼化忌，你在外常因無謂的應酬惹上麻煩、爭奪。
rules.en: Tan Lang in Hindrance: away from home, pointless socialising often drags you into trouble and rivalry.

source.quote: 每因无谓应酬而招惹麻烦

rules.text: 貪狼見〔吉化〕，你遷移在外，生活精彩，事業發達。
rules.en: Tan Lang meets 〔good transformations〕: away from home, life is lively and your career thrives.

source.quote: 亦主迁移在外精彩发达

rules.text: 同宮有火星或鈴星，在外熱鬧，多是場面應酬，知心朋友難得。
rules.en: With Huo Xing or Ling Xing in the palace, life away from home is lively but mostly social show; true friends are rare.

rules.text: 同宮有擎羊或陀羅，出門多是非困擾，往往由應酬遊宴而起。
rules.en: With Qing Yang or Tuo Luo in the palace, trouble follows you away from home, usually out of socialising.

source.quote: 且往往由应酬、游宴而致
